text:
Sasha Lin: Heads up — we’re doing a conditional shard cutover for API v2 (shard B -> new gateway) tonight at 21:00 UTC. Goal: 10% traffic soak, 5m ramp steps, 30m watch.
Kevin M: +1. Are we keeping v1 fallback enabled for the first hour?
Maya Patel: Yes, fallback stays on. If any errors > 3% in a 5m window we auto-roll back. Config is in deploy-configs: `deploy-configs/v2-cutover/shard-b.yml`.
Eli R: I pushed a small header-normalization hotfix to the gateway that only affects shard B. No schema changes.
Jen T: Can we add a temporary metric alert for unexpected 4xx patterns? Request path: `/v2/` and header `x-client-version` mismatch.
product-releases: Note for release notes — call out that older mobile SDKs (<=1.8.2) may see 422 on strict schema routes; we should recommend toggling the compatibility flag.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Sasha Lin for 2026-03-21T21:00:00Z to cluster eu-west-1. Steps: bake -> gradual-shift -> monitor. Rollback window: automatic on critical alerts, manual otherwise.
oncall-ops: I'll be on watch from 20:45–22:30 UTC. Pager rules updated to include the new metric `v2.gateway.error_rate.shard_b`.
Kevin M: Quick check — will dedupe/cache keys be preserved across gateway swap? We need to avoid cache stampede.
Maya Patel: Yes, prefix is `shardB:v2:` so existing keys continue to be honored. Cache TTLs unchanged.
Sasha Lin: Operator guidance for handoff: if latency P95 increases > 200ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows, escalate to eng-runtime and flip the fallback. Command to flip fallback: `POST /admin/route/fallback/shard_b?action=enable` (from ops VPN only).
Eli R: I tested the fallback flip locally — returns 200 and responses go back to v1 routing.
Jen T: I'll add the temporary 4xx alert: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{route=~"/v2/.*",status=~"4.."}[5m])) by (instance) > 10` and tie to the cutover runbook.
Sasha Lin: Cool. After 60m soak and no regressions we plan to increase to 50% then full over 2 hours. If mobile SDK telemetry shows any new schema errors we pause.
Maya Patel: Also enabling a short-lived canary key (header `x-cutover-canary`) to route 20 internal test keys through the path first. Test run at 20:50 UTC.
Eli R: Sending the test keys to #internal-load after this message.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic shift applied: 20 internal keys => shard B new gateway at 20:50 UTC.
oncall-ops: Canary observed: no errors, latency stable. Proceeding to 10% ramp at 21:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
Sasha Lin: Team, thumbs up — follow the runbook, ops will call if any anomalies. If anyone wants to opt-out tenants list now, DM me.
Kevin M: Thanks — standing by.
Maya Patel: Copy. I'll watch schema errors dashboard and tracer sampling.
product-releases: I pushed a short blurb to the release notes draft to warn about older SDKs.
Sasha Lin: Thanks all. Remember to annotate the deploy in the changelog with `#shardB-cutover` and include the rollback trigger timestamps.
